eval: (async()=>{const {Entity}=await import('/src/game/entities.js'); const g=__game,p=g.player,d=g.debug; class TestMob extends Entity { constructor(){ super(0.9,0.9); this.type='mob'; this.mobType='pig'; this.health=100; this.maxHealth=100; this.log=[]; this.inv=0; this._r={kind:'block',blockId:61,x:0,y:0,z:0,scale:0.9,light:240,flash:0}; } update(dt,game){ this.age+=dt; if(this.inv>0)this.inv-=dt; const b=this.body; b.vy-=32*dt; const f=b.onGround?Math.pow(0.546,dt*20):Math.pow(0.91,dt*20); b.vx*=f; b.vz*=f; b.move(game.world,b.vx*dt,b.vy*dt,b.vz*dt); this.updateLight(game.world);} hurt(a,cause,attacker){ if(this.inv>0.25) return false; this.inv=0.5; this.health-=a; this.log.push([a,cause,attacker===__game.player]); if(attacker){ let dx=this.x-attacker.x, dz=this.z-attacker.z; const l=Math.hypot(dx,dz)||1; this.body.vx=this.body.vx/2+dx/l*8; this.body.vz=this.body.vz/2+dz/l*8; this.body.vy=Math.min(8,this.body.vy/2+8);} return true;} getRenderItem(){ const r=this._r; r.x=this.x; r.y=this.y; r.z=this.z; r.light=this.light; r.flash=this.inv>0.25?0.6:0; return r;} } const x=Math.floor(p.x), z=Math.floor(p.z); const y=g.world.getTopY(x,z-3)+1; for(let dz=-5; dz<=0; dz++) for(let dx=-2; dx<=2; dx++){ const ty=g.world.getTopY(x+dx,z+dz); for(let yy=ty+1; yy<=ty+3; yy++) d.setBlock(x+dx,yy,z+dz,'air'); } const m=g.entities.add(new TestMob()); m.setPosition(p.x, g.world.getTopY(x,z-3)+1, p.z-2.5); window.__mob=m; d.lookAt(m.x, m.y+0.45, m.z); return {mob:[m.x,m.y,m.z], player:[p.x,p.y,p.z]}})()
